root_cause.text: In Bluetooth L2CAP's `l2cap_information_rsp()`, the code validated only the fixed `l2cap_info_rsp` header length and then accessed the variable-length `rsp->data` field for `L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK` and `L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN` without confirming the payload bytes were actually present, causing out-of-bounds reads on truncated responses.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit states `l2cap_information_rsp()` "checks that cmd_len covers the fixed l2cap_info_rsp header ... but then reads rsp->data without verifying that the payload is present," specifically `get_unaligned_le32(rsp->data)` needing `cmd_len >= 8` and `rsp->data[0]` needing `cmd_len >= 5`; the patch adds `if (cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32))` and `if (cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0]))` before those reads.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a length check before parsing the L2CAP feature mask to avoid reading past short information responses.
intent_record.what: In the L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK case of l2cap_information_rsp(), the direct assignment `conn->feat_mask = get_unaligned_le32(rsp->data);` was wrapped in a conditional so it only executes when `cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32)`.
intent_record.how: This prevents reading a 32-bit feature mask from `rsp->data` when the received response packet is shorter than the required header-plus-u32 size, avoiding out-of-bounds access and leaving `conn->feat_mask` unchanged for truncated packets.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a length check before accessing fixed-channel response data to avoid out-of-bounds reads from short L2CAP information responses.
intent_record.what: In the L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN case of l2cap_information_rsp(), the direct assignment of conn->remote_fixed_chan = rsp->data[0]; was wrapped in a conditional so it only executes when cmd_len is at least sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0]); the subsequent state updates remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: This prevents reading rsp->data[0] when the received response is shorter than required, avoiding an out-of-bounds access on malformed or truncated packets while still marking the feature-mask request as completed.

grouping_result.intent: Add a length check before accessing fixed-channel response data to avoid out-of-bounds reads from short L2CAP information responses.

consistency_review.core_intent: Add defensive length checks when parsing L2CAP information responses to prevent out-of-bounds reads from undersized packets.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly add the missing payload length validations in L2CAP information response parsing before accessing variable-length data fields for feature mask and fixed channels, which is exactly the root cause of the out-of-bounds read on truncated responses.

candidates.rationale: This reads a 32-bit value from the variable-length rsp->data field after only the fixed response header length was validated, so a truncated L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK response can trigger an out-of-bounds read.

This accesses the first byte of the variable-length rsp->data field for L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN without confirming that the payload contains at least one byte, enabling an out-of-bounds read on short responses.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement reads 4 bytes from the variable-length rsp->data field for L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK after only the fixed information response header length had been validated. If the response is truncated and does not contain those 4 payload bytes, this causes an out-of-bounds read.

This statement accesses the first byte of the variable-length rsp->data field for L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN without verifying that the payload includes at least one byte beyond the fixed header, allowing an out-of-bounds read on truncated responses.
